title: Make the search verb stop decoding every stored note on each call
outcome: Make the search verb stop decoding every stored note on each call
acceptance: On the live Engram store, an all-items search (search verb) for a phrase that matches nothing completes in under 1 s on an idle host, against about 2.3 s on build 7a1da3b7
Search results, their order and literal case-insensitive matching of complete note/gate text are unchanged, proven by the existing note-search tests
The temporary 60 s elapsed limit is returned to 10 s in the same change
